meta.data_label: simulated-table replay (mock CLI emulator, not Claude Code)
meta.independent_real_cli_runs_note: This harness never executes the Claude CLI. Every number here replays recorded outcomes; independent real CLI runs are produced only by caver8.live and are NOT part of this report.
meta.replay_caveat: Replay draws the same 66 recorded outcomes ([1, 2, 3] per configuration) again and again. Seed CIs capture schedule and policy randomness only, NOT the uncertainty of the recorded observations themselves.

f_stat_skew.description: skewed stationary: field_value / abnormal_exit / exec_mismatch heavy, unlike W_BASE; train and evaluation from the same weights

f_abrupt_boundary.description: abrupt shift at the train/eval boundary: train schema-heavy, evaluation field_value + abnormal_exit heavy from step 1

f_abrupt_after.description: abrupt shift after the boundary: abnormal_exit/timeout/matcher/exec-heavy steps 1-20, schema + field_value heavy steps 21-90

f_flat_shift.description: flat shift: timeout + exec_mismatch heavy steps 1-25, near-uniform steps 26-90

f_spike.description: transient spike: steps 1-40 base, 41-55 matcher spike (0.70), 56-90 fresh base cohort

f_gradual.description: gradual drift: P(case from the target cohort) = clip((t - 20) / 50, 0, 1), i.e. 0 up to step 20 and 1 from step 70; target is timeout + matcher heavy

meta.table_label: SIMULATED / HYBRID extended table: contains mock-CLI rows; NOT evidence about Claude Code

stats_methods.p_values: two-sided normal; Holm across all reported candidate comparisons
stats_methods.recovery: paired restricted mean (cap = horizon - change + 1), KM median, censoring rate
